senses.gloss: (b. h.) to squeeze, wring, esp. to wring out the blood of the bird sacrifice. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. VIII, Par. 7 הוא מוֹצֶה he wrings it; a. fr.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 6:5">Zeb. VI, 5</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—2) <cite ref="M02307">same</cite>.

senses.gloss: to pour out to the last drop, to drain. Ib. 64ᵇ מי כתיב יְמַצֶּה יִמָּצֵה וכ׳ (ed. punctuate יַמְצֶה, Hif.) it does not say (Lev. V, 9), ‘he shall pour out (the remainder) at the bottom &c.’, but ‘it shall be wrung out’, which means, that it will run out to the bottom of itself.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:8">Ter. <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:11">Gen. R. s. 85</cite>; s. 92 (play on <he>מצא</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 44:16">Gen. XLIV, 16</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא מְמַצֶּה וכ׳</he> as one drains a vessel and leaves nothing but the lees.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 59:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX</cite> (play on <he>מצא</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 18:22">Prov. XVIII, 22</cite>) <he>כשהאשה רעה היא מְמַצָּה</he> (<he>כל</he>) <he>הטובות כולן מביתו וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>ממַצֶּאֶת</he>, a. oth. variants) when the wife is bad, she drains all the good things out of his house and makes him poor; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 957:3">Yalk. Prov. 957</cite> <cite ref="M01675"><he>ממציא</he></cite> (read: <he>מְמַצֵּית</he>); a. fr.

Erub. IV, 11 (52ᵇ) אין המשוחות מְמַצִּין וכ׳ the surveyors (in marking distances for Sabbath limits) do not measure exactly (but mark within the limits), in order to allow for mistakes.—Trnsf. to sound one’s learning.
<cite ref="Menachot 18a:4">Men. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>למַצּוֹת מידותי</he> to have my own learning examined; <he>למ׳ מידותיו וכ׳</he> to sound the learning of &c.

senses.gloss: to be wrung out; to be emptied, drained Sifra Vayikra, Ḥob., Par. 10, ch. XVIII; Zeb. 64ᵇ שהשירין מִתְמַצִּים ליסוד where the remainder is poured out towards the bottom of the altar; a. fr. [Ib. VI, 4 (64ᵇ) היה מתמצה, read מְמַצֶּה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50.]—Y. R. Hash. I, 56ᵈ top; Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ עד כאן הן מִתְמַצּוֹת לילד וכ׳ up to that time (the first of Elul) the latest births of the old year (of those conceived before the first of Nisan) take place &c.—Trnsf. (with חשבון) to be exactly counted, to be finally settled. Y. Sot. I, 17ᵃ (he suffers a loss by the death of his ox &c.) והחשבון מִתְמַצֶּה and the account (of his sins) is settled; ib.; Num. R. s. 9 אחת מתארעא וכ׳, v. אָרַע I; Koh. R. to VII, 27.
